Introduction
The analog sensor cables are especially designed for our popular IO Expansion shield and sensors. It connects most of our analog sensor to the IO board.
This price includes 10 pieces of cables.
Latest Update: Change the analog sensor extension pin mapping to be compatible with the latest IO expansion shield and Romeo analog sensor expansion pinout.
Latest Pin mapping for Analog sensor extension
Red: PWR; Blue: Signal
